concerns.text: US-01 (physics teacher data generation, P1) is anchored only by FR-001; no Success Criterion covers it. All five SCs reference US-02/US-03. Add an SC measuring data-generation validity (e.g., determinism/reproducibility of generated trajectories, zero-corruption rate of rendered sequences) anchored to US-01.

concerns.location: spec.md:User Story 3, Acceptance Scenario 3 / Functional Requirements
concerns.text: The ablation study (US-03 scenario 3: 'varying friction... comparison table showing how changes in physical realism correlate with changes in LPIPS') has no backing FR or SC. Add an FR/SC for the ablation study or explicitly descope it.

US-03 requires comparison against a 'neural-teacher baseline', but no FR covers training/obtaining that baseline model (idea methodology: 'Train an identical student model using the original Causal Forcing++ protocol'). FR-004/FR-005 only cover evaluation. Add an FR for baseline construction anchored to US-03.
